title: attestation: Add CTLV operation handling
overview: This patch adds the translation layer between the generated CTLV attestation family (patch 14) and the provider/MR-journal core (patches 15-16): core/ctlv.c implements the per-operation handlers named by the family's op table. It also exports the op pre/post hooks, builds the generated family object into the attestation module, and wires drivers/attestation into the top-level Kconfig and Makefile so the whole subsystem is finally compiled.

files.purpose: Driver-API documentation for the attestation core; this patch adds a note on how MR_READ uses generations.

units.title: MR_READ generation semantics
units.summary: Documents that the continuation check uses mr_read_generation while the reply carries the journal boundary at which values were read.
units.details: Matches `ctlv_attestation_mr_read_query()` below: the cursor generation is compared with `att->mr_read_generation`, but the reply's `mr.generation` is `att->log->generation`.

units.title: Add ctlv.o and the generated family object
units.summary: Links core/ctlv.o and generated/ctlv_attestation_gen.o into attestation.o alongside core, events and mr.
units.details: The generated object supplies the family descriptor, cursor helpers and op table that reference the handlers defined in ctlv.c.

files.purpose: Provider/instance core; owns struct attestation and the per-instance lock.

units.title: Export ctlv_attestation_op_pre()
units.summary: Exports the pre-operation hook (which takes att->lock) in the ATTESTATION namespace.
units.details: Per-instance locking for CTLV ops is therefore available to the generated family code and to other modules such as the TDX family.

units.title: Export ctlv_attestation_op_post()
units.summary: Exports the matching post-operation hook that unlocks att->lock.

files.purpose: CTLV operation handlers for the attestation family: each ctlv_attestation_*_action/query function decodes a request cursor, calls into the provider or the MR journal (mr.c, events), and encodes the reply. They are invoked by the generated op table under att->lock (taken by ctlv_attestation_op_pre); the cursor accessors named ctlv_attestation_* come from generated/ctlv_attestation_gen.h.

units.title: Header and includes
units.summary: License line and includes, including the private internal.h with struct attestation and MR helpers.

units.title: attestation_evidence_object_find()
units.summary: Looks up a provider-supported evidence object by its format string.
units.details: Linear scan of `caps->objects`; returns the matching `attestation_evidence_supported_object` or NULL. Used when decoding evidence requests.

units.title: attestation_device_caps_put()
units.summary: Encodes the device capabilities nest: evidence limits and objects, and MR read/extend flags.
units.details:
- Evidence section is emitted only if `provider->evidence_caps` is set; one object nest per supported format, blob class PRIMARY and representation RAW.
- MR section is emitted only if `provider->mrs_count` is non-zero; flags derive from whether `mr_read` / `mr_extend` callbacks exist.
- Failures to put attributes are accumulated in `ok` and reported as -EMSGSIZE at the end so nests are always closed.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_device_get_action()
units.summary: Handler for the device GET op: caps nest followed by the generic device info nest.
units.details: The info nest is filled by `ctlv_stub_fill()` from the CTLV core's introspection support.

units.title: attestation_evidence_decode_objects() - resolve output blobs
units.summary: First phase: count the requested objects, allocate the array, and for each map format to a supported object and resolve its output blob.
units.details:
- Rejects unknown formats (-EOPNOTSUPP) and duplicate formats (-EINVAL).
- `..._evidence_data_resolve()` yields a blob reference (VA blob, patch 9) that must be released with `ctlv_blob_put()`.
- On errors the earlier-resolved blobs are put and the array freed.

units.title: attestation_evidence_decode_objects() - size checks and publish
units.summary: Second phase: validate blob capacity against the format's max_length and the running total against max_total_output_length, then hand the array to the caller.
units.details: Each output blob must be at least `supported->max_length` bytes; the sum of blob lengths is checked with `check_add_overflow` against the caps' total limit (-E2BIG). On success the array is returned through `decoded->objects` and `*objects_out`.

units.title: attestation_evidence_request_decode() and _free()
units.summary: Decodes the challenge (with length bounds from the caps) then the objects; the free helper puts every non-NULL output blob and frees the array.
units.details: `attestation_evidence_request_free()` tolerates entries whose `output` was already put and cleared by the action handler.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_evidence_get_action() - decode and call provider
units.summary: Handler for the evidence GET op: decode the request, call provider->evidence_get(), and check the reported lengths.
units.details:
- `mr_dependent` is true if any requested object has `binds_mrs`, meaning its content depends on measurement register state.
- The provider fills `result.object_lengths`; each must fit both the format's `max_length` and the resolved blob.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_evidence_get_action() - release blobs and reply
units.summary: Puts the output blobs (surfacing any put error), then writes the MR generation (if MR-bound) and per-object lengths into the reply.
units.details: `att->log->generation` is the journal boundary the evidence reflects; the lock held by the op hooks keeps it stable during the call. The `out:` label frees the length array and any remaining blobs.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_get_action()
units.summary: Handler for MR GET: look up one live MR by id and encode its properties.
units.details: Ids beyond UINT_MAX give -ERANGE; `attestation_mr_lookup_live()` (mr.c) returns an ERR_PTR for unknown or removed MRs; encoding is shared via `attestation_mr_props_encode()`.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_dump_query()
units.summary: Paginated dump of all MRs from the att->mrs xarray, resumable across query rounds.
units.details:
- The CTLV query cursor stores the next xarray index plus one; the query generation stores the journal generation, and a mismatch yields -ESTALE.
- When an item no longer fits, `ctlv_op_query_more()` returns the cursor to resume at; otherwise `ctlv_op_query_done()`.

units.title: attestation_mr_values_put()
units.summary: Encodes a digest set as repeated MR value nests (hash algorithm plus digest bytes).
units.details: Digest length comes from `hash_digest_size[algorithm]`; any failed put turns into -EMSGSIZE.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_read_query()
units.summary: Handler for MR READ: reads the current digests of one readable MR via the provider and returns them with the journal generation.
units.details:
- On continuation the query generation must equal `att->mr_read_generation`, else -ESTALE.
- Requires `props->readable`; allocates one digest slot per supported algorithm, calls `provider->mr_read()`, then `attestation_mr_values_validate()`.
- Replies with `att->log->generation` and the values, then completes the query with `ctlv_op_query_done()`.

units.title: attestation_digest_compare() and attestation_mr_extend_decode()
units.summary: Decodes the repeated MR value attributes of an extend request into a digest set sorted by algorithm.
units.details: Each value must name a known hash algorithm and carry exactly `hash_digest_size[algorithm]` bytes. Sorting by algorithm id gives a canonical order for validation against the MR's algorithm list and for the journal entry.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_extend_action()
units.summary: Handler for MR EXTEND: validate, prepare a change, extend through the journal, and report the resulting generation.
units.details:
- Requires a live MR with `props->extendable`.
- Pipeline: decode values, `attestation_mr_values_validate()`, `attestation_mr_change_prepare()` (allocations), then `attestation_mr_extend_locked()`, which calls the provider's `mr_extend` and publishes the log entry (see the journal documentation).
- The reply carries `entry->mr_generation`; the prepared change and decoded values are freed on all paths.

units.title: attestation_log_selected()
units.summary: Filter predicate: an entry is selected if no MR ids were requested or its id is in the list.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_log_get_query() - request parsing and range
units.summary: First part of the journal query: collect the MR selection, pick the snapshot boundary, and compute the [start, end] generation range.
units.details:
- Up to 256 distinct MR ids; duplicates give -EINVAL.
- On the first round the boundary is the current `att->log->generation`; on continuation it is the generation saved in the query state (-ESTALE if it is beyond the log).
- Optional start/end generations narrow the range; the first reply echoes the effective start and end.

units.title: ctlv_attestation_mr_log_get_query() - iteration
units.summary: Walks the entries xarray, skipping unselected MRs, and returns one entry per round via the query cursor.
units.details: The first round (cursor 0) only positions the cursor with `ctlv_op_query_more()` at the first matching entry's generation. Later rounds encode that entry, look ahead for the next match, and either request more or finish with `ctlv_op_query_done()`, keeping the boundary constant so results come from one snapshot.
